utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've been mapping out where all the old park equipment is. Do you know where we're meeting for the repairs?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, we're meeting at the community center on Saturday from 10 to 4. I'm so glad you're helping out!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll note that. The community center, Saturday 10 to 4. I'll make sure my map includes that as the base.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'll definitely mention it in my building's group chat. Thanks for telling me about it!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, thanks Nell! Every share helps—let's get the whole neighborhood involved!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No problem, I'm happy to help get the word out!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rey! Are you ready for the repair drive this weekend? I'm putting up flyers on main street—want to help?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive? I still don't know much about it. Sure, I can help with flyers, but tell me more first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's a community event where folks bring broken items and we fix them together. We're collecting spare parts and tools. Want to come help sort supplies?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? I'm sorry, I don't recall... could you remind me what that's about?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, it's a community event where we get volunteers to help fix things around the neighborhood—like leaky faucets or broken fences. Jules is helping connect us with electricians and plumbers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! Thanks for the reminder, Hana. I remember now—Jules mentioned something about that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Noah, good to see you! Are you available to discuss the repair drive schedule after pickup today?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, Mara mentioned Saturday morning at the community center. But I'm a bit fuzzy on the schedule—can you fill me in again?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's Saturday from 9am to noon at the community center. I can help sync it with the school pickup times if needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Uli, glad you're here. The repair drive's going well, but we could use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help for a bit, but I might have to leave early.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, any help is great. Can you sort through these donated tools?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, how's the repair drive going? I heard it was this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's this weekend, but I'm not sure we have all the parts. Do you know what's on the list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm not sure, but I can ask around and find out for you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Vik, do we know the exact times for Saturday? I need to plan my day.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sorry Eli, I'm still waiting to hear from the organizers about the exact times. I'll let you know as soon as I find out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, but I'd appreciate it if you could get those times soon. I can't have my day up in the air.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Tess, are you involved in the repair drive too? I'm helping sort donations on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's awesome, Sam! I'm so glad you're helping out. I was just telling Quinn and Eli about it—it's going to be a great event!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess! I'm really looking forward to it. Are you going to be sorting donations too?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe we should gather everyone and double-check the inventory before we attempt anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Double-checking inventory might be a good idea, but are you sure that's enough if we don't have the right parts?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let's find the list first, then we can see what we're missing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That's a bummer. I'll check around and see if anyone else has heard anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do. I'll ask a few others and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's a neighborhood thing where we fix broken stuff together. We're meeting at the community center this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Saturday morning at the center. I'll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, see you Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Dane, I'm interested in the repair drive, but I need to know the exact time and if there's a sign-up. I like to plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I'm not sure about the exact time or sign-up yet, Eli. I just got here and haven't heard the full details myself.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I hope someone figures it out soon. I don't like last-minute surprises.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Bo, glad you're interested! Oren and I were planning to chat after school pickup to sort out the schedule. Want to join us?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can swing by for a bit, but I've got to run after.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you then! We'll make it quick.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Gus, can you bring over the heavy tools tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Leo. I'll bring the toolbox with the heavy wrenches and the sledgehammer. What time works for you?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Morning, around 9. Thanks, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Leo. I'll be there Saturday to sort through everything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Sam! Thank you so much for volunteering. We'll see you Saturday at 10!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll be there at 10 sharp. See you then, Rosa!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would be great, Jules! Could you start with the community center contacts?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might have a broken chair... if that's the kind of thing you fix.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: A broken chair? I can add it to the list. Is it wood or metal? That'll help me match you with the right person.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, I'll get the posts up right away! Let's meet at the community center on Saturday morning to see how it's going.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, I'll bring an inventory list of what we have so far.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I'll have the flyers printed by then too. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can we check the online inventory or do you have a photo of the list?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don't have a photo, but maybe we can check the online inventory for cables and a power supply.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, let's pull up the online inventory on our phones and see what we have for cables and power supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? How's that going?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure that's going to help? Pia seemed pretty uncertain about it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, I think any effort helps, even if it's small. Have you talked to Pia about what's worrying her?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, are you going to the repair drive this weekend? I'm planning to bring my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, that's great! I'm sure we can find someone to help fix your toaster. I'll check with my contacts.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm really hoping they can fix it. Let me know what you find out from your contacts!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? I'm sorry, I don't recall... could you remind me what that's about?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Oren! It's this weekend at the community center – they're fixing broken electronics and appliances for free, and they need volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! That sounds great—I think I have a toaster that's been acting up. What time does it start on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's a neighborhood initiative where we fix broken items instead of throwing them away. We're meeting at the community center Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds interesting. What kind of things do people usually bring to fix?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, all sorts of things—small appliances, clothes, furniture, even electronics. Bring anything that needs fixing!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Nell, have you heard about the meeting point for the repair drive? I've been mapping the park equipment locations.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think Rosa said it's at the community center, down the street.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The community center? That makes sense—it's central. I'll update my map. Are we gathering inside or out front?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
